definitions: Align or position (something) in relation to the points of a compass or other specified positions.
Adjust or tailor (something) to a specified person or purpose.
Find one's position in relation to new and unfamiliar surroundings.
Direct (something) towards a particular goal or situation.
examples: The course is oriented towards the needs of the industry.
It took him a while to orient himself in the new city.
We need to orient our efforts towards customer satisfaction.
